title: What makes a cinephile... a cinephile?

commenti.body: My journey: Double features daily every summer at the Circle Theatre, Washington, D.C. Early member AFI Kennedy center. Multiple, multiple theatre viewings of many features (Lawrence of Arabia 40+ times). Gorging and taping everything when TCM came out. Film classes in college. Screenwriting interest in grad school. Film school after that. Multiple internships and various jobs on films. Probably 40 years worth of obsession and still love it. Happy to see revival houses coming back.
